basic_profile.bio: I'm a recent college graduate from the Midwest with a degree in computer science. I developed an interest in online gaming during my university days, especially games like Sea of Thieves. I'm currently working as a junior software developer at a tech startup. My free time is often spent exploring new games, learning about quantum computing, and tinkering with the latest cloud gaming services. I'm single and enjoy late-night gaming sessions, typically online between 10 PM and 2 AM CST. I dislike toxic gaming environments and overly competitive players.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid understanding of computer science principles due to my academic background. My knowledge of gaming comes from years of self-teaching and active participation in gaming communities. Recently, I've been diving into the world of quantum computing through online courses and discussions on Reddit.
